name: claude-red
description: 58 curated offensive security SKILL.md files for AI agents across 13 categories: Web Application (SQLi, XSS, SSRF, SSTI, XXE, IDOR, RCE, deserialization, race conditions, request smuggling, GraphQL, WAF bypass), Auth & Identity (JWT, OAuth), Active Directory, Wireless (WPA2/3, BLE, Zigbee, LoRa), Cloud (AWS/Azure/GCP), Mobile, IoT & Embedded, Infrastructure & Red Team (EDR evasion, shellcode, C2), Exploit Development, Fuzzing & VR, Reconnaissance (OSINT), AI Security, and Utility. Each skill is a drop-in SKILL.md file that primes AI agents with expert-level offensive methodology.

baseArgs: claude-red v0.1.0 — 58 offensive security skills. Use sc skills teach claude-red:quickstart
